en.content:
A non-isotropic solid metal cube has coefficients of linear expansion as :
5 10-5/oC along the x-axis and 5 10-6/oC along the y and the z-axis. If the coefficient of volume expansion of the solid is C 10-6/oC then the value of C is
en.explanation:
= x + y + z

C 10–6 = 5 × 10–5 + 5 × 10–6 + 5 × 10–6

C 10–6 = 50 × 10–6 + 10 × 10–6

C = 60

x-अक्ष के साथ 5 10-5/oसी और y और z-अक्ष के साथ 5 10-6/oसी। यदि घन के आयतन विस्तार का गुणांक C 10-6/oसी है तो C का मान क्या है
